topic_title: Vehicle Maintenance for Safety — Tires, Brakes & Lights
prompt: Under Texas vehicle safety inspection standards, what exterior lighting systems must be fully functional?

options.text: Only the driver-side low-beam headlight and center windshield defroster wire
Decorative underbody neon accent glow tubes and auxiliary roof rally lamps
Exterior lights are optional for passenger vehicles driven during daylight
Headlights, taillights, brake lights, turn signals, hazard lights, license lamp
